resources.string: Keep local performance and error records for up to 7 days, within 10 MB. Nothing uploads automatically.
Standard reports exclude dictated text, audio, vocabulary, clipboard contents, and text from other apps. Transcript capture below is a separate option.
Add live recognition events and resource samples while reproducing a problem. Uses the same privacy exclusions.
Review a technical summary, add optional notes, then share a ZIP with an agent or on GitHub.
Includes device and app information, recognition settings, recent technical events, and available standard S1-mini performance reports. Excludes recordings and captured transcripts.
Your notes are included exactly as entered. Avoid private information when posting publicly.
Unable to complete this diagnostic action. Please try again.
Crash evidence is best effort. An unfinished session does not prove a crash. Accepted delivery means Android accepted the text handoff, not that another app displayed it.
Delete standard app and S1-mini reports and prepared exports, and stop detailed mode. Saved recordings and separately captured transcripts remain available.
